hypothesis: When backtracking alone stalls, correcting the actual Adam displacement along derivatives of violated training-only exit margins can permit relation learning while preserving sampled correct exits.
comparison: Inherit all data, seeds, initialization, loss weights, guards, refresh schedule and attempted update budget from cycle_repair.json. Compare to the completed repair_guard condition; this adds only direction correction before the same finite guard and backtracking. Policy-dependent pools can diverge as before. No extension of the earlier run or test-selected checkpoint.
projection_semantics: For a rejected full Adam proposal, repeatedly find the largest finite guard-floor violation. At the unchanged pre-step parameters differentiate that exit margin, and add (violation+slack)*gradient/squared_gradient_norm to the proposed displacement. Recheck the finite candidate after each correction, up to eight. Then apply the original backtracking and rollback rules. Linearization alone never accepts a step; no guarantee outside the training-only guard cohort. Report accepted scales, rejected updates and direction-correction counts.
